notes.title: First patch is out
notes.content:
Patch 1 (10.09.15):
- fix: community levels were not playable if the game was not installed on the C:\ partition
- fix: level selection was freezing if many community levels were downloaded at the same time

Big thanks to MadDoggyca! He reported these bugs, stayed awake for the half of the night, shared his screen with me and helped me to find these bugs!
